title: One to One aur One to Many Relationships
objectives: Relationship ko property aur method dono tarah use karna

sections.heading: Relationships kya hain?
sections.body: Database tables aksar ek doosre se jude hote hain: ek user ke kai posts, ek post ke kai comments, ek user ka ek phone. Eloquent mein relationships **model ke methods** hote hain. Jab method ek relationship return karta hai, to tum `$user->posts` jaisa seedha likh sakte ho.

callout.text: Relationship = foreign key ka object-oriented roop. Table mein `posts.user_id`, model mein `$user->posts`.

sections.heading: One to One: hasOne aur belongsTo
sections.body: Ek user ka ek phone. Foreign key `phones.user_id` mein hogi. `hasOne` parent model (`User`) mein aur `belongsTo` (inverse) child model (`Phone`) mein likhte hain.
explain: Eloquent maan leta hai ki `phones` table mein `user_id` hai (parent model ka snake_case naam + `_id`).
`hasOne` / `hasMany` – foreign key child table mein hai (`phones.user_id`, `posts.user_id`).
`belongsTo` – yeh model foreign key rakhta hai (`phones.user_id`), is liye wo 'belongs to' user.
Return type (`HasOne`, `HasMany`, `BelongsTo`) likhna achhi aadat hai.

sections.heading: Property aur method: bada farak
sections.body: Relationship ko do tarah se likh sakte ho aur dono ka matlab alag hai:

code.code:
$user = User::find(1);

$phone = $user->phone;        // property: related model (ya null)
$posts = $user->posts;        // property: posts ka Collection (query chal gayi)

$active = $user->posts()      // method: abhi query builder hai
    ->where('is_active', true)
    ->latest()
    ->get();

$owner = Phone::find(1)->user;   // inverse

explain: `$user->posts()` (brackets ke saath) – query builder deta hai jisme aur conditions jod sakte ho.
Property se pehli baar data aane par query chalti hai (lazy loading), aage lesson 04 mein dekhenge isse kya dikkat hoti hai.

`dissociate()` foreign key ko null karta hai (column nullable ho).

sections.heading: withDefault aur chaperone
sections.body: Agar post ka author hata diya gaya ho (null), to `$post->user->name` error dega. `withDefault()` ek khali ya default model deta hai:
explain: `withDefault([...])` – relation null ho to default attributes wala naya model.
`chaperone()` – parent post ko children (comments) par automatically load kar deta hai, taaki `$comment->post` ke liye extra query na chale (13 docs mein hai).

versionDiff.heading: Relationships: Laravel 11, 12 aur 13
versionDiff.intro: `hasOne`, `hasMany`, `belongsTo` ka syntax teeno versions mein same hai.

items.11: Relationship methods return types ke saath (`HasOne`, `HasMany`, `BelongsTo`). `chaperone()` naye 11.x releases mein; apne patch ke docs dekho.
items.13: Same as 12. 13 docs mein `chaperone()` aur `withDefault()` dono documented hain.

errors.error: SQLSTATE: Column not found: 1054 Unknown column 'user_id' in 'where clause'
errors.cause: Table mein foreign key column nahi hai, ya naam convention se alag hai.
errors.fix: Migration mein `foreignId('user_id')` rakho, ya relationship mein custom key do: `hasMany(Post::class, 'author_id')`.

errors.error: Attempt to read property "name" on null
errors.cause: Relationship null hai (jaise phone nahi hai) aur tumne seedha property padhi.

errors.error: Add [title] to fillable property to allow mass assignment on [App\Models\Post]
errors.cause: `$user->posts()->create([...])` ke liye Post ke `$fillable` mein columns nahi hain.

exercise.intro: User, Phone aur Post ke relationships banao:
tasks: `phones` migration (user_id foreign key) banao aur `User::phone()` / `Phone::user()` likho

options: Pehla data deta hai, doosra query builder
quiz.why: Bina brackets ke data (Collection), brackets ke saath relationship query builder.

quiz.q: Foreign key kis table mein hoti hai: `User hasMany Post`?
quiz.why: `hasMany` mein child table (`posts`) mein `user_id` hoti hai.
`associate()` `belongsTo` ki foreign key set karta hai.

interview.a: `hasOne` parent par hota hai (jisme foreign key nahi hoti), `belongsTo` child par (jis table mein foreign key hai).

interview.q: Relationship property aur method mein farak?
interview.a: Property related data load karti hai. Method relationship query builder deta hai jisme aur constraints jod sakte ho.

interview.q: Eloquent foreign key ka naam kaise guess karta hai?
interview.a: Parent model ke naam ko snake_case mein badal kar `_id` jodta hai, jaise `user_id`.
Relation null ho to default attributes wala khali model deta hai, taaki null error na aaye.

summary: Property data deti hai, method query builder.
`create()` aur `associate()` related records banate hain; `withDefault()` null se bachata hai.
